reviews.text: It was very easy to get in touch with the business. I spoke with a live person, was told someone would be out to assess the situation, and got a quote the next day. I got an email with a date and time that the work would be done.
reviews.author: Cynthia P.

reviews.text: on time. great equipment to do the job. friendly and professional. took their time to do the job right. very fair pricing. good communicating on line. would highly recommend them.

reviews.text: I had a 90' foot tree come down in a storm and I started to stress from the moment that I noticed it until RH Tree Service stopped by to check out the problem.The man who I dealt with was very personable and knowledgeable. It was interesting talking with him.
